site_area_sqm.interpretation: Temporary recomputation denominator; not an official redline area.

official_site_area_sqm.reason: Official site polygon has not been supplied; the announcement value is approximate and is not substituted for a GIS redline.

concept_total_floor_area_sqm.reason: No surveyed floor count, official FAR, ownership, or building condition data is available; program envelopes are not enough to calculate floor area.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official boundary are absent.

building_height_m.reason: Approved height controls, aviation, heritage, and view-corridor constraints are absent.

simulation_success_rate.formula: tasks with outcome=success or outcome ending _success / simulation_task_count
simulation_success_rate.interpretation: All twelve fixed synthetic tasks reached their registered outcome; this is package logic only, not field performance.

tool_schema_pass_rate.interpretation: Reserved repository aggregate: eleven valid payloads passed schema and one preregistered malformed payload correctly remained invalid and triggered an audited HOLD. Expected behaviour is 12/12; this aggregate is not an unclosed package gap.

audit_completeness.interpretation: All twelve synthetic task records are complete, including the malformed-input HOLD record; this is not a field audit.

ai_off_rehearsal_success_rate.formula: synthetic same-task cases completed through staffed, paper, telephone or fixed spatial alternatives / simulation_task_count
ai_off_rehearsal_success_rate.interpretation: All twelve fixed synthetic tasks have a complete human, paper, telephone, or fixed-spatial equivalent; staffing and funding remain external HOLDs.
